exposure: Modified pathologic technique for gross examination of hysterectomy specimens with placenta in situ
modified pathologic technique for gross examination of hysterectomy specimens with placenta in situ
outcome: Reporting time for complete histopathology results
Number of samples taken for histologic examination
Number of histologic slides showing villous invasion
Accuracy of diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 48 patients with singleton pregnancies complicated by placenta low-lying/placenta previa accreta
finding: A modified pathologic technique for gross examination of hysterectomy specimens with placenta in situ, involving intraoperative and immediate postoperative examination, is more cost-effective, provides more accurate histologic sampling, and enhances the correlation between clinical and pathological data in diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum compared to standard methods.
